description: This file defines templates and classes for representing and manipulating 'Regularity Profiles' used in compile-time type trait checks, including support for creating, combining, and analyzing conformance profiles for types, especially in the context of C++ type traits and concepts.

classes.name: ConformanceErrors
classes.description: A class for collecting and reporting conformance test errors and successes, integrating with Google Test assertions.

methods.name: UnderlyingValue
methods.description: Converts an enum value to its underlying integral type.

methods.name: ConformanceErrors
methods.description: Constructor initializing error reporting with type name.

methods.name: addTestSuccess
methods.description: Records a successful test by name.

methods.name: addTestFailure
methods.description: Records a failed test with optional message parts.

methods.name: assertionResult
methods.description: Returns gtest AssertionResult indicating overall success or failure.

methods.name: expectFailedTests
methods.description: Reports tests that were expected to fail but did not.

methods.name: outputDivider
methods.description: Outputs a visual divider in error report.

methods.name: addTestFailureImpl
methods.description: Helper for variadic failure message parts.

methods.name: PropertiesOf
methods.description: Extracts the 'properties' type from a type T.

methods.name: PropertiesOfT
methods.description: Type alias for PropertiesOf<T>.

methods.name: ExpectedFunctionKindList
methods.description: Generates a string listing expected function support levels.

methods.name: ExpectModelOfImpl
methods.description: Checks if a type's property support level is within expected bounds.

methods.name: hashable_support_of
methods.description: Checks if a type is hashable.

methods.name: ConformanceProfile
methods.description: Template struct representing a type's conformance profile with support levels for various traits.

methods.name: conservative_hashable_support_of
methods.description: Conditionally checks hash support based on support for standard hash.

methods.name: SyntacticConformanceProfileOf
methods.description: Generates a conformance profile based on trait checks.

methods.name: CombineProfiles
methods.description: Template for combining multiple profiles into a single profile with support for min/max support levels.

methods.name: CombineProfilesImpl
methods.description: Implementation detail for combining profiles, computing min or max support levels.

methods.name: StrongProfileTypedef
methods.description: Defines a type alias for a profile's properties.

methods.name: IsProfile
methods.description: Trait to check if a type is a conformance profile.
